operators.name: softmax_dim1
semantics: Corresponds to F.softmax(x / temperature, dim=1) in reference.
Divides input x by temperature, then applies softmax along dimension 1 (channels) for each spatial location and batch.
Preserves input shape and strides, returns float32 tensor on same CUDA device.
Follows PyTorch softmax numerical stability: subtract max along dim for each slice before exp and sum; output values sum to 1 along dim=1.
Handles non-contiguous input correctly by respecting strides.

operators.name: mul_square
semantics: Corresponds to torch.mul(x, x) in reference.
Element-wise multiplication of input with itself.
Returns float32 tensor on same CUDA device, same shape and strides as input.
Input x is divided by scalar self.temperature (0.5 for given init).
Softmax is applied over dimension 1 (channels) independently for each batch and spatial position.
Result has same shape [16,1024,32,32], float32, CUDA.
Element-wise square of the softmax output.
Final output is the squared softmax tensor, same shape and dtype.
